questions.question: Whom did Zechariah see standing before the angel in chapter 3?
options: Cyrus the king, releasing the captives
Ezra the scribe, reading the law aloud
Zerubbabel the governor, building the temple
Joshua the high priest, with Satan accusing him
questions.answer: Joshua the high priest, with Satan accusing him

questions.question: What was done with Joshua's filthy garments?
options: They were left on him still as a sign of all of his guilt
They were removed, and he was clothed in pure vestments
They were taken and given over to the accuser instead
They were burned with fire before all of the people
questions.answer: They were removed, and he was clothed in pure vestments

questions.question: God promised to bring his servant the Branch in Zechariah 3.
